section_summary.extract_value: This section reviews theoretical reasons why sexual minority men may have lower body appreciation, noting that the relationship between body appreciation and sexual orientation has not previously been investigated among men. It highlights sociocultural mechanisms — including heightened appearance pressures, internalisation of appearance ideals, and upward social comparisons within appearance-potent gay male subcultures — that could explain lower body appreciation.
section_summary.evidence_source: 'The relationship between body appreciation and sexual orientation has not been previously investigated among men.'; 'Sexual minority men live in a particularly appearance-potent subculture, with greater overvaluation of physical appearance and sexual objectification of male bodies (Hospers & Jansen, 2005; Jankowski, Fawkner, Slater, & Tiggemann, 2014).'
